verdict.rationale: Docs say a plain-language statement like "Users can't tell which invoices are overdue" is enough to start, without knowing which files change. An agent then reads the input, fills in the intention (agreed purpose plus editable deliverables) and proposes tasks, which become approvable task contracts that carry relevant skills. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration; detail on how tasks are scoped (e.g., file targets or acceptance criteria); explicit confirmation that auto-proposal applies to developer-typed intentions, not just widget submissions.
